info.title: MarketSDK API
info.description:
A headless API for a peer-to-peer marketplace inside your product.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`. The key alone decides the marketplace and the mode: `msk_test_` keys reach test mode, `msk_live_` keys live mode, and data never crosses.

Every POST accepts `Idempotency-Key`; a repeat within 24 hours returns the original response. Lists are cursor-based. Money is integer minor units with an ISO currency code. Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC. Errors share one envelope with a `request_id`.

Abuse reports: report@marketsdk.com.

bearer.description: An API key: msk_test_sk_…, msk_live_sk_…, or a publishable msk_…_pk_… key where allowed.

fixed_amount.description: Minor units, in the marketplace currency.

evidence_days.description: Days both parties have to give evidence once a dispute opens.

decision_days.description: Days the customer's team has to decide once evidence closes. After that the dispute is marked overdue.

prohibited_keywords.description: Words or phrases that block publication when found in a listing title or description, ignoring case.

read_only.description: Set while the marketplace answers reads only, for example after a missed payment. Changes are refused with 403 `marketplace_read_only`. Null when open.

external_id.description: Your own id for this person. Unique per marketplace.

status.description: From the latest identity verification. Once verified, a seller stays verified.

`not_started` before the first onboarding link; `pending` while Stripe onboarding is unfinished or under review; `enabled` when the seller can receive transfers; `restricted` when Stripe needs more from the seller.

requirements_due.description: What Stripe still needs from the seller, by Stripe's field names. Send a new onboarding link to collect it.

stripe_account.description: The seller's connected account on your Stripe account.

completed_orders.description: order_completed events in the rolling window.

backed_out.description: backed_out events in the rolling window.

disputes_lost.description: dispute_lost events in the rolling window.

review_count.description: Visible reviews in the rolling window.

average_rating.description: Plain mean of those ratings, or null.

score.description: Null until the minimum number of events.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `starting_after` (or `cursor` for search) to get the next page.

country.description: The seller's country, two letters. Used only when the seller's Stripe account is created, on the first link. Defaults to your Stripe account's country.
